title: Killa Bubblegum Nic Pouches - 13.2mg / pouch
description: Killa Bubblegum Nicotine Pouches offers a classic bubblegum flavour while delivering a smooth and balanced nicotine experience. Each pouch contains 13.2mg of nicotine, making it suitable for adult users who enjoy a satisfying yet measured nicotine release. The Bubblegum flavour offers a sweet and familiar taste, delivering a smooth, long-lasting experience that’s easy to enjoy. These pouches are tobacco-free, providing a clean and convenient alternative to traditional nicotine products. The discreet design of Killa Bubblegum pouches makes them ideal for use in various settings, whether you're on the move, at work, or in a social environment where traditional nicotine use isn’t feasible. Killa Nicotine Pouches are crafted with a focus on consistency and quality, ensuring a reliable nicotine experience. Simply place a pouch between your upper lip and gum, and enjoy a steady release of nicotine for up to 30 minutes. With 20 pouches per pack, Killa Bubblegum offers a practical and flavoursome option for those who enjoy a sweet, nostalgic twist while relieving nicotine cravings. How to Use: 1 Place a pouch between your upper lip and gum for a steady nicotine release for up to 30min. 2 Place the used nicotine pouch in the designated top compartment of the pack. 3 Dispose of the pouch. PLEASE DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH
